clips.title: The story
paras: At Bael Modan, Nitroglycerin helps the dwarves drive their excavation through tauren lands. Their soldiers and officers carry the volatile chemical, which can also be used against the fortress.

Bael Modan's dwarves dig into the ancestral lands of the Stonespire tauren with heavy drillers and volatile chemicals. At the excavation site and its fortified keep, they keep nitroglycerin close to blast deep holes and break apart hills. Soldiers and officers, including Lord Cyrik Blackforge, carry vials of the fluid as the digging continues.
